scope: Read-only review of each unmerged peer delta against private Music preparation, not a combined build or final port.

findings.summary: Speaking-face narrowing can be enabled without scoped context, leaving chat messages on the legacy personal builder.
evidence: worker.rs:1373 constructs ScopedSystem only with LAMP_SECOND_SCOPED_CONTEXT=on.
second_provider.rs:1817-1826 narrows the live lease and discards prepared chat.
second_provider.rs:2226-2229 falls back to the legacy builder without ScopedSystem.
worker.rs:1312-1328,1363-1378 legacy builder selects current/sticky person and loads personal memory/history.
second_provider/tests.rs:4135-4144 always supplies a scoped builder.
findings.validation: Root and independent reviewer verified the call chain; no runtime or lamp reproduction.

music_narrowing_conclusion: No stale person-bound grant exists before final words on the inspected production path: prepared chat buffers events without running tools; narrowing discards it; the admitted final audio runner carries the live lease. Music context binds request identity, not person or scope epoch.
expected_text_conflicts: If #2008 lands, union second_provider/tests.rs speaking-face case with Music peer helpers and Called/private-offer/NEWS tests.
Union docs/switches.md speaking-face row and current upstream wait-cue defaults.
preserve: If #2007 lands, retain its three-argument spoken_character and immediate remember/recall/forget declarations alongside Music audio runner.
combined_regressions_if_landed: Prepared old Music call then other-face narrowing and fresh different final Music call: no old dispatch, one fresh offer, runner sees room scope, boot/session/request/privacy binding unchanged.
Same-face and ambiguous/no-face controls retain scope; empty final words, synthetic Called and carried-only input cannot authorize Music.
Camera revocation, newer request or Stop during final narrowing prevent memory calls and Music offers; keep shutdown and IPC-credit deadlines.
Few-tools memory calls with direct/wrapped Music retain scope and keep private offers out of model messages; cover actual scoped-context activation fix.
limitations: Both peer heads were unmerged when read. Preserve their actual merged revisions during the final port.
No source changes, Cargo checks, provider sessions or device access during this audit.
